description: Mirror of FORMULATION.md sections 3a and 6 (simplicity threshold, archetype clustering, demand/competition/opportunity). Field names now match 00_config.module_spec.json exactly (that file was corrected after an earlier draft of this spec was written with a stale name -- max_complexity_score was renamed to simplicity_percentile; this spec previously lagged that rename and has now been fixed to match).
signature:
@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AnalysisParams:
    simplicity_percentile: float
    trailing_window_months: int
    min_cluster_size: int
    opportunity_weights: dict[str, float]
    min_tag_votes: int
    max_tags_per_game: int
    tag_distance_threshold: float | None
    clustering_linkage: str
    generic_tag_max_share: float = 1.0
docstring:
Analysis-stage constants (FORMULATION.md sections 3a and 6).

Attributes:
    simplicity_percentile: A percentile in (0, 1], not an absolute score -- FORMULATION.md section 3a defines 'simple enough to build' as the bottom 40th percentile (locked value: 0.40) of C_i within the same run's candidate set. apply_simplicity_filter computes the actual C_i cutoff value per run from this percentile; this field is never itself a complexity score.
    trailing_window_months: W. Locked value: 24.
    min_cluster_size: Locked value: 5 games.
    opportunity_weights: {'demand': 0.40, 'competition': 0.30, 'simplicity': 0.30} -- w_D, w_K, w_Sigma.
    min_tag_votes: Tags below this vote count are excluded before clustering.
    max_tags_per_game: Cap on tags retained per app in extract_tags.
    tag_distance_threshold: The empirically-frozen Jaccard distance-cut threshold for agglomerative clustering (FORMULATION.md section 6). None until scripts/freeze_empirical_parameters.py has run once against run 1's data (ADR-012); cluster_tags must fall back to a locally-computed threshold search (see cluster_tags spec) when this is None, and use the frozen value verbatim once present, never re-deriving it silently on a run where a frozen value already exists.
    clustering_linkage: Agglomerative-clustering linkage criterion, e.g. 'average' or 'complete'. Not specified by FORMULATION.md section 6 at all -- flagged as an open judgment call below; 'average' linkage is the conventional default for Jaccard-distance hierarchical clustering in the literature and is assumed here pending explicit confirmation.

JUDGMENT CALL / INCONSISTENCY (flag to user): FORMULATION.md section 6 locks the clustering *method* (agglomerative, Jaccard tag-distance, no genre anchor, empirically-derived cut threshold) but specifies neither (a) the linkage criterion (single/complete/average/ward -- ward is invalid for a non-Euclidean Jaccard distance matrix, so the real choice is among single/complete/average), nor (b) the exact search procedure for picking the distance-cut threshold beyond the qualitative goal 'keep median cluster size in a reasonable range... tuned so at least half of clusters clear the minimum-cluster-size rule'. Both are needed to write a deterministic, testable cluster_tags implementation and are currently filled in by this spec as an assumption (average linkage; threshold search framed as 'smallest cut such that at least 50% of resulting clusters have >= min_cluster_size members', scanning the matrix's distinct distance values) rather than as a locked decision.
    generic_tag_max_share: Tags carried by more than this share of the clustered games are excluded from clustering and from game assignment (FORMULATION.md section 6). In (0, 1]; 1.0 disables the exclusion. Locked value: 0.15.
preconditions: tag_distance_threshold is None or 0.0 <= tag_distance_threshold <= 1.0 (Jaccard distance range)
postconditions: Instance is frozen for the run

edge_cases.expected_behavior: ParameterError, since Jaccard distance is bounded in [0, 1] by construction
ParameterError -- ward linkage requires a Euclidean distance and is invalid for a precomputed Jaccard distance matrix

unit_tests.name: test_opportunity_weights_exact_keys_and_sum
unit_tests.description: opportunity_weights with an extra or missing key, or a sum != 1.0, raises ParameterError.

unit_tests.name: test_none_threshold_accepted_pre_freeze
unit_tests.description: tag_distance_threshold omitted from TOML loads as None.
